name: rust-cargo
description: Curated MIT rule pack for Rust Cargo workspaces and Clippy pedantic checks.

rules.title: Cargo.lock needs update when --locked is passed
rules.error_template: error: the lock file Cargo.lock needs to be updated but --locked was passed to prevent this
rules.fix_summary: After editing `Cargo.toml` dependencies, run `cargo check --workspace` once without `--locked` to refresh `Cargo.lock`, then re-run CI checks with `--locked`.
